prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: dry penne, a jar of tomato sauce, a ball of mozzarella — one second still. Then motion: pasta rattling into boiling water, sauce poured over the drained penne in a red wave and folded through, mozzarella torn by hand into ragged chunks and buried into the red. Money shot: out of the oven — edges charred and crisp, a serving spoon lifting a mass with mozzarella stretching in long backlit strands that refuse to break. Final beat: the stretch finally folding onto the plate. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the pasta rattle, then the cheese stretch. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: o macarrão de forno de três ingredientes — o de padaria, feito em casa, com borda de queijo torradinha. **Sábado que vem: [A] abobrinha, ovo e queijo ou [B] calabresa, cebola e batata? Comenta A ou B 👇**
